reviewed_lead.title: Hubert Howe Bancroft, History of Utah, 1540–1886, chapter on 1869–1877, footnote 31 (p. 666)
reviewed_lead.observed_claim: The footnote describes Governor Woods, Major Gordon and troops breaking a jail wall with a battering ram to release a soldier.
limits: Modern transcription has not yet been checked against a digitized original.
The passage does not specify ram material, dimensions, fittings, supports or an exact date.
No physical form is approved from this lead.
Partisan descriptions of the arrest and release must not be copied as neutral facts.

rejected_as_form_evidence.reason: A 1903 fictional film synopsis cannot authenticate an 1865–1890 Western ram.
The inspected summary supports artillery destruction, not a specific timber ram.

next_steps: Locate original Bancroft scan and cited manuscript or contemporary newspaper account.
Confirm the event date and actual ram construction before modelling.
Find period visual evidence or a documented simple reconstruction; do not invent a medieval wheeled siege engine.
